# ecdna-bench: pip requirements for a CPU-only installation (Python 3.10)
#
# Same versions as env/environment.yml, with the CPU build of PyTorch.
# Use this file when conda is not available:
#
#   python3.10 -m venv ~/venvs/ecdna-bench
#   source ~/venvs/ecdna-bench/bin/activate        # Windows: ~\venvs\ecdna-bench\Scripts\activate
#   python -m pip install --upgrade pip
#   python -m pip install -r env/requirements-cpu.txt
#   python -m pip install -e . --no-deps
#
# The extra index supplies the CPU-only PyTorch wheels on Linux and Windows
# (about 200 MB instead of several GB of CUDA libraries). On macOS the
# standard wheels are used. PyTorch 2.8 has no wheels for Intel macOS.

--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
